title: Connected product family
slide_intent: Sequence related devices into a shared scene so viewers can understand the breadth of a service without losing the family resemblance.
strategic_value: A recurring colored stage can connect Xfinity’s communication, entertainment and home products.
demonstration: The animation presents a video-call phone, entertainment screen and home camera, then assembles a larger group of screens and hardware on a colored stage.
practical_value: Use a change from single products to an ensemble when the audience needs to understand both individual uses and a connected offering.

content_islands.name: Individual device presentations
content_islands.spec: Show each device against a colored floor and background with a soft grounding shadow.

content_islands.name: Product ensemble
content_islands.spec: Bring the displays and hardware into one group, with the largest screen behind the smaller devices.

reference_purposes.Expression: The product renderings share saturated stage colors, soft shadows and shifting viewpoints.
reference_purposes.Application: The final ensemble applies a shared presentation language to phones, screens, a remote and home hardware.
